name: Ulor se Bysen

facts.text: Level 73, 30,000 health; fights linked with his brother Jehrog se Bysen. Casts Essence Devourer.
Bysen means 'example, pattern, model', and also 'command, precept' (Bosworth-Toller).

story:
In the old hall the word bysen meant an example, the pattern a young man was told to follow, and also a command. The ogres gave the title to two brothers, Ulor and Jehrog, and every young ogre in Krondon is told to be like them. Ulor is the younger and the hungrier. He feeds on the strength of whoever stands before him, as if to prove he can take whatever the hall's enemies have, and he never fights without his brother at his back.

The younger example. In the old hall the word bysen meant an example, the pattern a young man was told to follow, and also a command. The hall-folk gave it as a title to the best of each generation. The ogres gave it to two brothers, Ulor and Jehrog, and every young ogre in Krondon is brought to their room and told to be like them.

What he takes. Ulor is the younger and the hungrier. He devours the strength of whoever stands before him, as if to prove to the watching young that an ogre of Krondon can take whatever the hall's enemies have. He never fights without his brother at his back. When one of the bysen is struck, both answer, because that is the lesson: an ogre of Krondon does not fight alone and does not fall alone. The young ogres who watch them fight are Orylle's next generation, and the brothers know that every fight in their room is also a class. The ghosts of the hall's own bysen, the true examples, drift through that room too, and the ghosts say the brothers would have made good examples once, if anyone had ever taught them what an example is for.
legend:
The brothers come together and fall together. Ulor drains the life out of whoever he faces; Jehrog strips your body resist and covers you in sores. Kill one at a time with the whole raid and keep the healers on whoever is sored.

Ulor is the softer of the two by health; many raids kill him first to end the drain sooner. Whichever you pick, the whole raid hits the same brother. His drain heals him, so the healers on the tank must keep pace; a tank that dips under half is feeding Ulor. When Ulor falls, Jehrog grows angry: save a cooldown for him.

loremasterTopic.text: An example, in the old tongue, and a command too. The ogres gave it as a title to two brothers, Ulor and Jehrog, whom every young ogre is told to follow. They never fight apart.

bookPage: Every young ogre in Krondon is brought to the brothers' room and told to be like them. We found a dozen of the young ones crowded in the doorway when we came, and they did not flee; they watched, as they had been told to. Ulor, the younger, took the strength out of our tank as a boy drinks milk, and grinned at the doorway while he did it. Jehrog opened our bodies to harm and covered us in sores. They fought side by side, and when Ulor fell, Jehrog roared to him to stand. The young ogres in the doorway learned something that night. I hope it was the right thing.
